cost_switch.rule: If GLM's median cost per run in the pre-pilot exceeds threshold_median_usd_per_run, then before the main phase either set pin to alternative_pin (a new arm id) or set decision to 'accept' (GLM may stop early at its cap). The batch refuses the main phase until one is recorded.

luna.effective_temperature: provider default: temperature is not a supported parameter on this endpoint, so the requested 0.2 is ignored

free_tier.note: 50 requests/day while lifetime purchases are below $10 (1,000/day at $10 or more; override with batch --free-requests-per-day). The day is UTC. accepted_served_models is the exact model string replies and the generation audit should report. Its base id (without ':free') and dated variants ('<base>-YYYYMMDD', with or without ':free') are accepted only when every call reported exactly $0, the zero-cost guard was on and the generation audit confirmed $0 for every generation; anything else halts the arm.

hash_note: sha256 of each file with CRLF normalized to LF

phases.P1: pre-pilot, unscored (experiments/runs/pilot): every arm x pilot_cases via `batch --pilot`
phases.P2: main A, headline Q1-Q5: hidden faults + healthy
phases.P3: main B, parity Q2: visible faults

rules.free_arm: nemotron runs only as ':free' with $0 price, $0 cap, no fallbacks, max_price 0/0 and the agent's zero-cost guard; data_collection 'allow' for this arm only (user-approved). It halts permanently if any run reports cost > 0, a served model outside the free variant (its base id and dated '-YYYYMMDD' variants count as the free variant only with a verified $0), an unverifiable $0, a permanent unavailability, or availability failures on 3 distinct UTC days without a completed run. A 429 or transient provider error pauses it (availability failure, not a model failure, no re-queue used). It starts a run only if the UTC day's request budget (50/day, worst case 16 requests per run) covers a worst-case run. 'If Nemotron would be paid, don't execute it; use it only if free; otherwise keep 3 models.'
rules.frozen: prompt, tools, budget (15 incl. 2 baseline), max_tokens 8192, client max_retries 1 and the arms are frozen for the matrix; the pre-pilot may change infrastructure only, judged on tokens and errors, never on diagnoses
rules.glm_cost_switch: if GLM's median cost per run in the pre-pilot exceeds $0.109, before the main phase either switch GLM to the novita-fp8 pin (new arm id glm@novita-fp8, $0.63/$1.98) or accept that GLM may stop early at its $3.40 cap (arms.json cost_switch.decision 'accept'); the batch refuses the main phase until one is recorded. z-ai fp8 stays the default
rules.headline_family: the 4 enabled arms (luna, glm, gemma and the free nemotron arm): Holm over 4 tests per rule, so an arm needs at least 8 discordant pairs (alpha .05/4). If the free arm halts permanently, the family becomes the 3 paid arms (at least 7 pairs) and the decision is recorded in <runs>/free_arm_halt.json
primary: Q1 strict hidden accuracy = human 'correct' / human-valid hidden-fault runs per arm, Wilson 95%, with per-fault k/n; paired exact McNemar against rules R1, R2 and R3 on the same runs, Holm-corrected over the headline arm family
Q2 healthy false-alarm rate = human 'wrong' / human-valid healthy runs, pooled over the headline arms, Wilson 95% (per-arm values descriptive only)
rules.requeue: an invalid attempt not caused by the model is re-run once at the end of the schedule; interrupted, key-limit and free-arm availability attempts do not count; model-caused invalids are outcomes, not re-run

rubric.broker_stopped: Names kafka AND that the broker is stopped/exited.
rubric.client_timeout_too_low: Names go-server, its Redis client timeout setting(s) AND that the value is too low.
rubric.cpu_throttled: Names go-server AND its CPU limit/quota or CPU starvation.
rubric.enricher_paused: Names go-enricher AND that its container is paused/frozen.
rubric.healthy: Any asserted fault is wrong (false alarm); 'no supported issue' or an abstention is correct.
rubric.ingestion_paused: Names go-server AND that its container is paused/frozen.
rubric.latency_enricher: Names go-enricher AND network delay/latency on it. Blaming Redis, Kafka or go-server is wrong.
rubric.latency_injected: Names go-server AND network delay/latency on it. Blaming Redis or Kafka as the cause is wrong.
rubric.redis_node_stopped: Names redis2 (not just 'a redis node') AND that it is stopped/exited.

rules.rule_r0: every container whose state in evidence entry 0 is 'exited' or 'paused'; else healthy
rules.rule_r1: first service in zookeeper,kafka,redis1,redis2,redis3,go-server,go-enricher,prometheus whose state in evidence entry 0 is not 'running' (absent counts); else healthy
rules.rule_r2: R1; if healthy, the single required service whose entry-0 status is 'Up' < 120 s while every other required service is older (recently restarted); else healthy
rules.rule_r3: cause-naming runbook on the model-free runbook snapshots (experiments.runbook_rule): (a) Go service config differs from the pre-injection snapshot -> service and setting; (b) p50 latency ratio or error ratio above threshold -> service, then (c) CPU signal (GOMAXPROCS dropped or CPU rate above threshold) -> cpu, else latency -> network delay, else errors; otherwise abstain. Thresholds come only from healthy-run data (r3_thresholds.json); scored for localization and strict diagnosis
rules.scoring: human labels in experiments/human_labels.csv (filled through the model-blind label sheet, experiments.label_sheet) are the only score; the auto-labeller is a second rater reported as agreement (Cohen's kappa), never a score
secondary: localization and detection accuracy (labels localized, detected)
ITT hidden accuracy: runs invalid because of the model (unparseable or token-limited conclusion) count as wrong; infrastructure, provider and availability invalids stay excluded
P(correct | confirmed) under enforced and self-reported confidence (Q2b, Q4); the downgrade rule reported both ways: wrong confirmations caught and correct confirmations downgraded
cost per correct diagnosis (Q3), Fisher exact arm vs arm
pass^k for k = 1, 2, 4, unbiased estimator C(c,k)/C(n,k) (Q5)
Cohen's kappa auto-labeller vs blind human labels (Q6); manipulation-check pass share
registered comparisons: localization (latency_injected vs latency_enricher) and mechanism (latency_injected vs cpu_throttled)
sensitivity: hidden accuracy without client_timeout_too_low; without runs failing the manipulation check
invalid attempts by cause; availability failures separately
rules.stop: an arm stops before a run when its spend (pre-pilot included) plus its per-run reservation would exceed its cap; the reservation is the token-model worst case until the arm has a completed paid run, then max(worst case, 1.5 x its highest observed run cost); no run starts when the recorded spend of all arms (pre-pilot included) plus its reservation would exceed the global budget (arms.json spend_guard, $5.25 under a $5.50 key limit); a run whose cost was not recorded (agent killed at the runner timeout or crashed first) counts at the reservation, or its audited cost if larger (cost_estimated); an OpenRouter HTTP 401/402/403 or 'Key limit exceeded' stops the batch and does not use up a re-queue (a 429 does not stop it)
rules.validity: runner validity_errors (a running-target fault whose container is not running after injection is invalid as 'target not running after injection'), plus provider drift and an incomplete generation audit; invalid attempts stay in the attempted count
